correctness.rationale: Taking adjacent differences of the full indexed output forces a difference of two sources to be constant on the gcd classes. A full window samples every class equally, so the one residual constraint is that the class shifts sum to zero. This gives exactly the normalized-pattern and summed-minimum invariants, and legal shifts form the stated bounded-composition coefficient list. Inclusion–exclusion gives the pattern multiplicities, and counting one output per offset sum gives a^d + d b a^(d−1), with a=q^m−(q−1)^m and b=(q−1)^m. For the maximum, the equal-width coefficient sequence of (1+…+z^a0)^d, a0=q−1, strictly increases up to the middle for d≥2: the d=2 sequence is triangular, and the first difference for larger d at k is the difference of coefficients at k and k−a0−1 in the preceding power. For 1≤k≤floor(d a0/2) the former index is in support and strictly closer to the preceding center whenever both are in support. At either central index there is a full-width composition with any specified entry equal to a0, so reducing any width loses a composition at either possible peak. Thus only constant reads attain the peak, with precisely the indicated parity count. The argument also includes the injective d=1 and total-sum ℓ=n cases. The ternary width triples yield the displayed seven frequencies.
correctness.replay: python3 /tmp/opencode/frozen_nov24_replay.py 4; independently formed full outputs for 7,837 sources in ten cases, checked image, central maximum and equality cases (both parities), and recovered all seven ternary example frequencies. The frozen loop bounds independently give the reported 168 parameter triples and 599,000 source instances before the separate ternary tests; the uploaded code was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Finite replay corroborates but is not the all-parameter proof. Conclusions concern indexed integer reads, not unordered, modular, or noisy observations.
